title: The Nine O'Clock Horde
summary: Every night at nine the horde arrives under one woman's window. Tonight she finds out why.

beats.text: Recording. Every night at nine, the horde arrives under my window. Every night. Always nine.
Sixty minutes of silence, hands over my mouth, while they look up.
Seven nights. Nobody keeps a schedule that regular. Not even the dead.
So I searched for what happens in this flat at nine. Nothing.
Then my phone lit up. An alarm I never knew about, set to vibrate. Daily. Nine p.m.
I'd set it to remind me to eat. A soft buzz, ringing the dinner bell.
I deleted it at 8:59. The street filled, as usual. Nine o'clock came.
Nothing buzzed. They stood there, confused, then drifted away one by one into the rain.
I'm eating dinner now. Quietly. Whoever finds this: check your alarms.
